# Iron axe

Internal ID: AxeIron | Type: Axe | Source: Forge | Usage: Wood cutting | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Iron x30, Leather Scraps x3 | Attack speed: 2.0 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.2 range, 90 angle, 0.6 height, vertical, no multitarget penalty | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Iron axe is the fourth one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Ancient, Birch, Beech, Fir, Oak and Pine trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.
